name: numeric-keypad
title: NumericKeypad
description: A 3×4 digit keypad for amounts, phone numbers and PINs: digits only, a `00` key for amounts and an empty slot otherwise, delete always bottom-right, left-to-right in every locale. One tab stop; arrow keys move linearly through the keys (Left/Right only, no Up/Down). Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.
